text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Yes... Yes, yes, yes!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I did it! I nailed it! I did just as well here
as I did at
the spring Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I bet everyone's—

text_block_list.name: Townsman
text_block_list.text:
Didja see that, central chumps? That
there's our
very own Inari One!

text_block_list.name: Racer with Purple Scrunchie
text_block_list.text: Inariii! The Pride of Oi!

text_block_list.name: Female Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Inari One was amazing! If she was able to
run like
that after her performance at
the spring Tenno
Sho, she might actually
be the real deal!

text_block_list.name: Male Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, maybe she can even level with
Oguri!
Imagine how awesome it'd be to
see them face
off!

text_block_list.name: Male Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Now it feels like an ever greater shame
that she
didn't compete in any central
races during her
classic year. She's such
a great runner—I would've
loved to see
her race!

text_block_list.name: Female Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Same! Can you imagine if she'd been at
the Arima
Kinen with Tamamo Cross?
That would've been
incredible.

text_block_list.name: Reporter in Flat Cap
text_block_list.text:
Inari One has really done it. After seeing
her run
at the spring Tenno Sho and
today, there's no
room for doubt
anymore. She's truly got what it
takes!

text_block_list.name: Reporter in Flat Cap
text_block_list.text:
Now I've just gotta get her the attention
she
deserves! I should write an article
about her... I'll
title it, "The Racer
Carrying the Hopes and
Dreams of the
Regionals"!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
No, hang on. It's still too early to get so
excited.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I haven't raced against Oguri 'n' Creek
yet. The
real fight doesn't start until
then!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Keep your head in the game, Inari One!
You're
not even close to becomin'
Umamusume of the
Year yet!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inari One may have won the Takarazuka
Kinen,
but she remains quite tense long
after the race
ends.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: This isn't enough.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I needa win more races! I needa win an
even
bigger race!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Tell me, Boss! What should I run in next?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Tell me, Boss! What should I run in next?
choice_data_list: その前に、少しいいかな？

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's the deal?
choice_data_list: その前に、少しいいかな？

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've noticed something off about her
behavior
lately.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She used to beam with happiness before
and after
races, like she was celebrating
at a festival.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But now...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: No way, I—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Er, sorry. Maybe you're right.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Er, sorry. Maybe you're right.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Everyone who ran today was super
strong. And
it's not just them I gotta
worry about. There's still
Oguri 'n' the
others from this generation I needa

contend with.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
But unless I can prove my worth to
everyone,
there's no way I can reach the
top 'n' become
Umamusume of the Year.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
When I think about that, I just can't be
satisfied
with my run today.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine now, though, thanks to you.
Your words
cooled my head right back
down.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine now, though, thanks to you.
Your words
cooled my head right back
down.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
There's no point freakin' out. I just gotta
use
today's race as a steppin' stone to
the next race
'n' keep movin' forward!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inari One looks a little more like her
usual self as
she smiles after her
declaration.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good! I'm gonna leave my mark
there the
same way I did in spring 'n'
shock the world with
what I've got!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's all but certain that Oguri Cap and
Super
Creek will be coming back from
their time off for
the autumn Tenno Sho.
choice_data_list: これまでで1番厳しい戦いになるぞ
これまでで1番厳しい戦いになるよ

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I know. But I gotta beat Oguri 'n' Creek
at some
point or another if I'm gonna
prove that I'm the
best, and this is the
perfect chance to try.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
By the way, we gonna be chargin'
straight ahead
into the autumn Tenno
Sho or are we makin' a pit
stop
somewhere else first?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If we use the Mainichi Okan as a lead-in
to the
autumn Tenno Sho, we'll have a
chance to do
last-minute adjustments as
needed.
choice_data_list: いや、『毎日王冠』にも出よう

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Plus, if Oguri Cap and the others also
run in the
Mainichi Okan, we'll be able
to get a sense for
how they'll perform at
the big race, too.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
All right! Oguri and Creek better watch
out,
'cause I'm gonna beat the stuffin'
outta them!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The tension in the air earlier has
vanished, and I
feel like I can breathe
easier. But...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Has Inari One really returned to her
normal self?
Unfortunately, I have no
way to know for sure.
